name: Down The River's Edge
source:
As the sun sets on the Old West, a young outlaw is faced with a dire choice: his freedom or sparing the man he loves.

Experience Javi's story as he turns from a hopeful young man into a grizzled outlaw. 

Love... Betrayal... Showdowns at sunrise...

A thrilling adventure awaits!

[From [url=https://therackoon.itch.io/down-the-rivers-edge]Itch.io[/url]]
